name: Edwards Lifesciences

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Edwards Lifesciences logo.png, 274x364 px)

description: Edwards Lifesciences is a pure-play structural-heart company: it sells transcatheter heart valves and repair devices, plus surgical heart valves, to hospitals. Transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR, the SAPIEN valve) is 74 percent of sales. Revenue is mostly one valve per procedure, so price and procedure volume are the drivers. It sold its Critical Care product group in 2024 and now books transition-services income from the buyer.

sub.name: Surgical and hospital devices and diagnostics

businessLines.name: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR)
businessLines.how: Sells SAPIEN transcatheter heart valves and delivery systems to hospitals, one valve per procedure; revenue follows procedure volume and mix.

businessLines.name: Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT)
businessLines.how: Sells transcatheter repair and replacement devices for mitral and tricuspid valves to hospitals, per procedure; early-stage and fast-growing.

businessLines.name: Surgical Structural Heart
businessLines.how: Sells surgical heart valves and repair products to hospitals for open-heart surgery, per procedure.

brands.name: SAPIEN 3 Ultra RESILIA valve
brands.note: primary driver of TAVR growth in the US and Europe; no revenue disclosed
